# Lack of Input Validation in Plugin Protocols

The defined Protocol methods do not specify or enforce validation on their inputs (e.g., untrusted artifact data, query strings, publication dirs, or LLM schemas), potentially allowing unchecked values to propagate through plugin boundaries.
